home.faithTitle: Learning the faith. Living it together.
home.faithCopy: Sunday School brings together scripture, prayer, the teachings of the Church, friendship, and service. It is part of the life of the parish, where each generation helps the next grow in faith.
home.quoteLabel: In the life of the Church
home.quote: Teach them diligently to your children.
home.quoteCopy: Learning, worship, fellowship, and service - held together in the parish community.
home.toolsTitle: Care for the school’s work with a little more order.
home.toolsCopy: Simple Senbet helps authorized school staff keep records for students, classes, attendance, and learning in one place.
home.wayTitle: Less time on paperwork. More time with your community.
home.wayCopy: Simple Senbet brings the everyday work of a Sunday School into one dependable system. Leaders can keep information current, teachers can focus on their classes, and school records stay easy to find.
home.studentsCopy: Keep student profiles and family details organized, with the context your school needs.
home.classesCopy: Coordinate weekly attendance, class groups, and teaching assignments with less manual work.
home.progressCopy: Bring courses, assessments, and academic progress into one reliable school record.
home.stepsTitle: A simple path from setup to a well-run school.
home.step1Copy: School leaders establish the academic year, classes, and teaching structure.
home.step2Copy: Authorized staff add learners, teachers, and the right school roles.
home.step3Copy: Record attendance and learning as your school year moves forward.
home.faqIntro: Still have a question? Our team can point you in the right direction.
home.faq1q: Who can use the school portal?
home.faq1a: Access is provided by your Sunday School administrator. Ask your parish school office to create or update your account.
home.faq2a: Public self-registration is not enabled. Authorized school staff manage accounts and assign roles for their community.
home.faq3a: Depending on their role and permissions, staff can manage student information, classes, attendance, assessments, and school records.
home.faq4q: I need help signing in. What should I do?
home.faq4a: Use the password reset page if your account email is active, or contact your school administrator for help with your account.

about.title: Technology in service of Sunday School.
about.intro: Simple Senbet supports the sacred work of teaching and caring for young people in the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church.
about.missionTitle: Bring the practical work into one clear place.
about.p1: Sunday School is more than a weekly lesson. It is where children learn the teachings of the Church, take part in worship, build friendships, and discover how faith guides daily life.
about.p2: Behind each class is practical work: keeping student records current, arranging classes and teachers, recording attendance, and following learning through the year. Simple Senbet gives authorized school staff a shared workspace for those responsibilities.
about.p3: The goal is simple: dependable school records that help teachers and leaders spend more time supporting their community.
about.valuesTitle: A school is built around people.
about.valuesIntro: Our tools are shaped around the needs of learners, teachers, and parish school leaders.
about.value1Copy: Make room for scripture, prayer, church tradition, and thoughtful questions at every age.
about.value2Copy: Give teachers and school leaders the information they need to know and support their students.
about.value3Copy: Support the people who give their time to teach, guide, and care for the parish’s young people.
about.approachTitle: Clear roles. Useful records. Ongoing support.
about.organizeCopy: Set academic years, classes, and the people responsible for each one.
about.coordinateCopy: Give each staff member access suited to their responsibilities.
about.growCopy: Maintain attendance and learning records as the school year progresses.
about.ctaTitle: Let’s talk about your school’s needs.

privacy.title: Parish privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: Simple Senbet Sunday School platform
privacy.intro: Simple Senbet prioritizes the dignity, privacy, and safety of Sunday School children, families, teachers, and church servants. This policy explains how information is handled for parish school administration.
privacy.collectedBody: Authorized parish registrars and administrators enter student names, family emergency contacts, class enrollments, attendance, and learning progress.
privacy.useBody: Information supports parish administration, Sunday School teaching, family communication, attendance, and financial accountability. The platform does not sell information or share it with advertising services.
privacy.accessBody: Access is limited by each user school role. Teachers see information needed for their assigned classes; only authorized finance staff can view finance records.

terms.title: School platform terms of service
terms.subtitle: Simple Senbet Sunday School platform
terms.intro: Simple Senbet supports the administration of Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Sunday Schools. Authorized users agree to follow parish policies, protect confidential information, and use access according to their assigned responsibilities.
terms.credentialsBody: Each user must sign in with their own account provided by an administrator. Do not share account credentials. Users are responsible for activity carried out through their account.
terms.recordsBody: Student profiles, attendance, learning progress, and family contact details are confidential. Use them only for legitimate school duties and within the access provided to your role.
terms.stewardshipBody: Keep school, member, and financial records accurate. Use the platform in support of the Sunday School community and its educational mission.
